name: Suspicious Hoofprints
summary: Tracks of hooves stretch off from the Shady Rest Inn, whose bare frame still smokes. A few can be seen clearly, while more rows are nearly lost in the marsh's soft ground. Krog at Brackenwall Village is the one to report them to.

sections.title: Prints in the Mud
sections.body: The Shady Rest Inn is a bare frame now, still smoking, and trails of hoofprints stretch off from it. Some impressions are easy to see; others can hardly be made out in the soft ground. Krog at Brackenwall Village should hear about them.

sections.title: Krog's Reply
sections.body: Krog allows that the quilboar may have done it, or even the centaur, since both have a sizeable presence in the Barrens and the deed would not be hard to believe of them. Krog adds that the inn was not only burned: the inn's owner also lost a woman and a pup, both killed. Krog will send Kagoro to learn where the tracks lead.

faq.answer: They lead away from the Shady Rest Inn, whose bare frame still smokes, over the marsh's soft ground.

faq.q: Who should hear about the hoofprints?
faq.answer: Krog, at Brackenwall Village, is the one to report them to.
A few are clearly visible, and further rows are nearly impossible to see in the mud.
